move: product cards slide left five times over drifting blurred bubbles
how: Cream stage with six blurred (46px) pastel discs orbiting on integer-cycle ellipses, driven directly from t. A track of five glass cards (backdrop-filter blur 20px) is duplicated so five steps of 428px land on an identical frame. Every 0.18D from 0.09D the track slides -428px more (expo.inOut, 0.9s); the passing card shrinks to 0.9, blurs 10px and dims to 0.6 (power2.in, 0.45s), the arriving card lifts y -18 (expo.out) and settles (power2.inOut), and the pager pill moves. Brand and title text are static.
adapt: Replace the items array (name, note, price, gradient pair), the brand and title, and the bubble colours; keep STEP = card width + gap, N steps at D/N spacing and the 0.9s expo.inOut slide.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the field bubbles, the doubled track and pager; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with steps at 0.09D + i*0.18D plus a {u:0->1, ease:none} tween whose onUpdate moves the bubbles (the __fx.seek override). Scope '.track', '.card', '.pager i' to el.
caveats: the track ends at -5*STEP, not 0; the loop only closes because the card set is duplicated
animated filter blur on cards plus backdrop-filter and a blur(46px) field is heavy
